mapper.select: SELECT * FROM matches WHERE external_id = #{externalId} AND competition = #{competition}
SELECT * FROM matches WHERE competition = #{competition} ORDER BY match_time ASC
SELECT * FROM matches WHERE DATE(match_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') = CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' ORDER BY match_time ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM matches WHERE status NOT IN ('FINISHED', 'CANCELLED', 'POSTPONED') AND match_time < NOW() ORDER BY match_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO matches ( external_id, competition, home_team_code, away_team_code, home_team_name, away_team_name, home_team_crest, away_team_crest, match_time, predict_deadline, stage, group_name, matchday, home_score, away_score, home_score_et, away_score_et, home_score_pk, away_score_pk, winner, status, last_synced_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{externalId}, #{competition}, #{homeTeamCode}, #{awayTeamCode}, #{homeTeamName}, #{awayTeamName}, #{homeTeamCrest}, #{awayTeamCrest}, #{matchTime}, #{predictDeadline}, #{stage}, #{groupName}, #{matchday}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{homeScoreEt}, #{awayScoreEt}, #{homeScorePk}, #{awayScorePk}, #{winner}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (external_id, competition) DO UPDATE SET home_team_code = EXCLUDED.home_team_code, away_team_code = EXCLUDED.away_team_code, home_team_name = EXCLUDED.home_team_name, away_team_name = EXCLUDED.away_team_name, home_team_crest = EXCLUDED.home_team_crest, away_team_crest = EXCLUDED.away_team_crest, match_time = EXCLUDED.match_time, predict_deadline = EXCLUDED.predict_deadline, stage = EXCLUDED.stage, group_name = EXCLUDED.group_name, matchday = EXCLUDED.matchday, home_score = EXCLUDED.home_score, away_score = EXCLUDED.away_score, home_score_et = EXCLUDED.home_score_et, away_score_et = EXCLUDED.away_score_et, home_score_pk = EXCLUDED.home_score_pk, away_score_pk = EXCLUDED.away_score_pk, winner = EXCLUDED.winner, status = EXCLUDED.status, last_synced_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
